profile.headline: Senior Full-Stack Engineer | Robotics, Digital Media, E-commerce
profile.geoLocationName: Los Angeles County, California, United States

positions.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and managed AI warehouse execution and management software used by all customers. Contributed to expansion from single fulfillment product to complete warehouse execution system with 10+ modules. 
-Created cloud mobile order fulfillment application contributing to 50% of yearly revenue after 4 years
-Built real-time analytics dashboards and 15+ widgets using React, Grafana, PostgreSQL, and Python
-Led integration efforts with customer ERP systems enabling expansion to 50+ locations
-Developed reporting tools, event signaling, data visualizations, and 3D warehouse applications using TypeScript, React, PostgreSQL, and Django
-Led Agile stand-ups and retrospectives for all cross-functional engineering teams and mentored junior engineers
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Presentations · Systems Design · Front-End Development · TypeScript · Problem Solving · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Data Pipelines · Attention to Detail · Architecture · Resolving Issues · Deployment Strategies · Back-End Web Development · Google Material Design · HTML5 · Technical Presentations · Client Side · Microservices · Code Review

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
-Decreased average integration time from weeks to hours by developing data integration application used by all customers to extract, transform, load data using HTTP, PostgreSQL, XML, CSV, MySQL, and GraphQL
-Developed animated visualizations for mobile execution software using React, TypeScript, and SVG to increase picking performance by over 30%
-Built modules enabling automated and user-driven inventory control and auditing increasing inventory accuracy to over 98%
-Transitioned front-end applications to use Material Design framework increasing user satisfaction by 30%
-Optimized core PostgreSQL queries for execution system to ensure fast API response times
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Presentations · Systems Design · Front-End Development · TypeScript · Problem Solving · Data Pipelines · React.js · Attention to Detail · Architecture · Resolving Issues · Back-End Web Development · Google Material Design · HTML5 · Client Side · Microservices · Code Review

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
-Partnered with landlords in New York to build a network of furnished rentals and application to connect users to businesses in their community.
-Managed 8 properties with renters in higher education, business travel, and medical industries.
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Presentations · Systems Design · Front-End Development · Attention to Detail · Fundraising · Google Material Design · HTML5 · Client Side

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with the UI and Enterprise Applications teams to:
-Create customer-facing video streaming products and enterprise software for content delivery network serving thousands of customers and resellers.
-Creating award-winning billing model engine enabling 4x growth of services (managing 200M annually), video streaming tools, and monitoring solutions.
-Managed direct report and led team of 8 developing applications for parent/subsidiary integrations, Salesforce, Service Now, NetSuite, and internal applications.
positions.insights: Skills: Systems Design · Front-End Development · Leadership · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · React.js · Architecture · Back-End Web Development · AngularJS · Technical Presentations · Client Side · Microservices · MongoDB · Code Review · Ember.js

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Created media asset and database management software in Perl, Java, and C++. Developed end-to-end media aggregation process with a web portal that interacts with our numerous SQL databases. Performed unit, load, and integration tests in a multiple-developer environment and generated documentation.
positions.insights: Skills: Systems Design · Attention to Detail

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Developed blog and e-commerce platform. Monitored analytics and conformed website to optimize web traffic utilization.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Worked closely with the company president and lead engineers in all facets of daily operation. I spent time researching and using their metal and thin film deposition technology. I also completely redesigned and authored content for the company website to increase and optimize their exposure.

positions.title: Student Brand Manager
positions.description: Focused on marketing to students on and around campus in various ways to build the image of the brand. The position also entailed coordinating events and building relationships with local accounts.
